thread:
Alex Chen: quick triage sync — recurring OOMs in kv-shard-17 over last 3 days. postmortem notes pointed to fragmentation + slow GC. want to assign owners + concrete next steps.
Priya Patel: ok, i'm happy to own profiling and a reproducible test. i'll run jemalloc + heap profiles this morning and share artifacts.
Ben Rodriguez: i'll take limits & runtime knobs (LMAP, arena settings) — plan to try lowering max_cache_bytes for the shard to 48GB and enable aggressive background GC on canary.
Maya Singh: i'll own rollout checklist and canary gating (metrics + latency guardrails). will add a smoke test for KV read p95.
Alex Chen: thanks. timeline proposals: Priya: artifacts by EOD today; Ben: canary change by tomorrow morning; Maya: canary gating rules by tomorrow noon. anyone object?
Priya Patel: no objections. note: we should capture allocation stack traces at 2x and 4x load profiles. i'll attach scripts.
Ben Rodriguez: fyi i ran an alloc-sample on dev and saw recurring 16MB anonymous mappings from cache-merge path. possible double retention. will paste logs.
infra-bot: deploy started: canary/kv-shard-17/limit-adjust-2026-04-15 (initiated by Ben Rodriguez)
Maya Singh: adding the following gating: fail canary if p95 latency increases >10ms OR memory RSS > threshold for 5min. also add eviction-rate alert spike + error-rate.
Alex Chen: decision: proceed with canary. Ben to roll, Priya to monitor alloc traces, Maya to watch gates + rollback if triggered.
Priya Patel: quick note — i'll enable jemalloc background purge and run frag histogram. command i used: ```jeprof --show_bytes /path/to/binary heap.prof | head -n 50``` will upload profiles to /tmp/kv-profiles/179975.
Ben Rodriguez: rollback plan in PR (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kv-runtime/pull/482) — contains a toggle: KV_FRAGMENT_COMPACTION=false -> true, plus max_cache_bytes env override.
Maya Singh: scheduling a 30m post-canary sync in #eng-runtime at 17:30 to review metrics.
Alex Chen: ownership recap: Priya (profiling + reports), Ben (limits/flags + PR), Maya (canary gates + rollout). deliverables and deadlines in thread. i'll follow up with a short postmortem addendum once we have final root cause.
Priya Patel: initial profiles uploaded: /tmp/kv-profiles/179975/frag_hist.txt (high fragmentation buckets at >2MB). adding notes now.
Ben Rodriguez: canary succeeded for 45min, then memory trend flattened. pushing to prod tomorrow 03:00 UTC if no regressions.
Maya Singh: left a checklist in the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/kv/frag-runbook (added steps: enable jemalloc purge, set compaction=True, monitor eviction-rate).
Alex Chen: long-term items: (1) add continuous frag histogram export to telemetry, (2) investigate compacting GC pass during low qps, (3) evaluate alternative allocators for shard processes. mark owners next week.
Priya Patel: one more thing — spotted a repeated pattern: larger seq-length requests correlate with more KV cache churn. i'll add a short eval to reproduce.
Ben Rodriguez: noted. i'll add an adaptive cache trimming option that triggers on sustained high churn.
Alex Chen: thanks all. marking action items in Asana and will ping owners. :thumbsup:
